items.html: It follows that the three aspects of the interiority of the GAR of ZA first clothed the three aspects of the externality over the three lower ones of the NHY of Ima; and afterwards he returned and ascended, clothing the three aspects of the interiority of the GAR of ZA over the three aspects of the interiority of the NHY of Ima, by means of the three aspects of Ibur, Yenika and Mochin; and the three aspects of the externality of the NHY of Ima descended, to be clothed over the three aspects of the externality of the three middle ones of ZA. And likewise in all the ascents.
